description: This file defines the MemoryStorage class implementing in-memory configuration storage for Drupal, including methods for CRUD operations, collection management, and data encoding/decoding.

classes.name: MemoryStorage
classes.description: A class providing in-memory configuration storage implementing StorageInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes MemoryStorage with an optional collection name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration item exists.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a configuration item by name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a configuration item.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration item names, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all configuration items, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection sharing the same config object.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Returns all collection names excluding default and empty collections.
